name: Folderly
author: wpfolderly

sections.description:
Transform Your WordPress Media Library with Professional Folder Organization

Folderly is the ultimate WordPress media library folder manager that helps you organize thousands of images, videos, PDFs, and documents into an intuitive folder structure. Stop wasting time searching through endless media files – organize your WordPress media library like a pro!

🎯 Perfect For:
* Photographers and content creators with large image libraries
* E-commerce stores managing thousands of product images
* Bloggers organizing featured images and graphics
* Digital agencies handling multiple client media assets
* Educational sites managing course materials and documents
* News websites with extensive photo archives
* Anyone frustrated with WordPress default media library

🚀 Boost Your Media Library Productivity by 10X

Managing your WordPress media files shouldn’t be frustrating. Folderly brings desktop-like folder management to your WordPress media library, making it easy to organize, find, and manage your media files in seconds instead of minutes.

⭐ Powerful Media Library Features:

📁 Unlimited Media Folders
Create unlimited folders to organize your WordPress media library exactly how you want. Structure your images, videos, and documents in a logical hierarchy that makes sense for your workflow.

🖱️ Drag-and-Drop Media Management
Simply drag and drop files between folders in your WordPress media library. Move single files or bulk select hundreds of images and organize them with one quick action. Works seamlessly in both grid and list view.

🔍 Advanced Media Search & Filter
Find any media file instantly with powerful search and filter capabilities. Search by filename, filter by folder, or combine both to locate the exact media file you need in your WordPress library.

⚡ Lightning-Fast Performance
Optimized for speed! Folderly handles thousands of media files without slowing down your WordPress admin. Smart caching ensures your media library loads fast, even with extensive folder structures.

🔄 Import from Other Media Plugins
Switching from another media folder plugin? Import your existing folder structure with one click. Folderly supports imports from FileBird, Real Media Library, Media Library Folders, and more.

💎 Virtual Folders (Non-Destructive)
All folders are virtual – your original file URLs and locations remain unchanged. Organize worry-free knowing your media files, links, and embedded images will continue working perfectly.

🎨 Clean & Intuitive Interface
Beautiful, modern interface that feels natural to WordPress users. No learning curve – start organizing your media library immediately with familiar drag-and-drop controls.

🔐 Advanced User Permissions
Control folder access with granular user permission settings. Perfect for multi-author blogs and agencies managing client media assets.

🔗 Universal Compatibility
Works seamlessly in WordPress media library, Gutenberg editor, classic editor, and all media upload interfaces throughout WordPress admin.

🎯 Why WordPress Professionals Choose Folderly:

✅ Save Hours Every Week – Stop scrolling through thousands of unorganized media files
✅ Professional Organization – Present well-organized media libraries to clients
✅ Scale Without Limits – Manage 10,000+ media files without performance issues
✅ Zero Risk Migration – Virtual folders mean zero risk to existing content
✅ Better Team Collaboration – Shared folder structure helps teams stay organized
✅ SEO-Friendly – Organized media helps you manage image alt text and metadata better

🛠️ Complete Page Builder & Theme Integration

Folderly works flawlessly with every major WordPress page builder and theme. Your organized media library folders appear everywhere you select images:

Page Builders:

✅ Elementor
✅ Beaver Builder
✅ Brizy Builder

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended):
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
3. Search for “Folderly” in the search bar
4. Click “Install Now” on the Folderly plugin
5. Click “Activate” to enable the plugin
6. Go to Media → Library to start organizing your media files into folders!

Manual Installation:
1. Download the Folderly plugin ZIP file
2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
4. Click “Activate Plugin”
5. Navigate to your Media Library and start creating folders!

First-Time Setup:
Once activated, Folderly integrates directly into your WordPress media library. No configuration needed! Simply:
* Open your Media Library
* Click the “+” button to create your first folder
* Start dragging and dropping media files into folders
* Enjoy your organized WordPress media library!
sections.faq:
What is Folderly and why do I need it?

Folderly is a WordPress media library folder manager that helps you organize images, videos, PDFs, and other media files into folders – just like organizing files on your computer. If you have hundreds or thousands of media files, Folderly saves you time by making it easy to find and manage your media assets.

How does Folderly organize my WordPress media library?

Folderly creates virtual folders in your WordPress media library. You can create unlimited folders and sub-folders, then drag and drop media files to organize them. It works exactly like organizing files on your desktop computer, but inside WordPress.

Will Folderly affect my existing media files, URLs, or embedded images?

Absolutely not! Folderly uses virtual folders, which means your actual file URLs and locations remain completely unchanged. All your embedded images, featured images, and media links will continue working perfectly. You can organize freely without any risk to your website.

Can I organize media files that are already uploaded?

Yes! Folderly works with all existing media files in your WordPress library. Simply drag and drop them into folders to organize them. You can also organize new files as you upload them.

Does Folderly work with the Gutenberg block editor?

Yes! Folderly works seamlessly with the Gutenberg editor, Classic editor, and all WordPress media interfaces. Your folder structure appears whenever you select images in any WordPress editor.

Is Folderly compatible with WooCommerce product images?

Yes! Folderly works perfectly with WooCommerce. You can organize product images, gallery images, and category images into folders for easy management of your e-commerce media library.

Can I import folders from other media library plugins?

Yes! Folderly includes one-click import tools for popular media folder plugins including FileBird, Real Media Library, Media Library Folders, and more. Your existing folder structure transfers seamlessly.

How many folders can I create with Folderly?

With Folderly, you can create unlimited folders to organize your WordPress media library exactly how you need it. There are no artificial limits on folder organization.

Does Folderly slow down my WordPress site?

No! Folderly is built for performance. It uses smart caching and optimized code to handle thousands of media files and folders without impacting your site speed or WordPress admin performance.

Will Folderly work with my page builder (Elementor, Divi, etc.)?

Yes, Folderly is designed to work seamlessly with most WordPress plugins and themes. However, if you encounter any compatibility issues, please reach out to our support team for assistance.

Is there a limit to how many folders I can create?

In the Pro version of Folderly, you can create and manage unlimited folders, including nested structures, to organize your content as extensively as you need.

How do I get support?

For support questions, visit our support forum or check our support page.
